source_claim: evaluation cascades use increasingly difficult test ensembles to promote promising candidates and prune less promising candidates before larger budgets are spent; paper-ready evidence must link candidate-level promotion and prune decisions to next-stage exposure and stage-specific rules
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve has runtime cascade attrition reports, stage evidence summaries, hypothesis-test policy reports, and a runtime transition matrix with promotion-decision attribution, next-stage exposure linkage, bounded candidate ids, and denominator reconciliation. Configured stages can also record strictly increasing difficulty/scale rationale and content-hashed declared-data or eval-input test-set identities. A checked four-seed 2x2 matrix fixture calibrates known rank-7 promotion and rank-8 rejection. It does not claim AlphaEvolve-style cascade-efficiency evidence with benchmark seed/sample policy, counterfactual full-evaluation costs, or observed wall-clock cost savings.
